Scholarships and loans - University of Amsterdam Scholarships and loans The University of Amsterdam (UvA) aims to attract the world’s brightest students to its international classrooms. For that reason, it has established several scholarship programmes specifically designed to offer talented and motivated international students the opportunity to pursue a degree at the UvA. Amsterdam Merit Scholarship The Amsterdam Merit Scholarship is for outstanding students from outside the EU/EEA who plan to do a Master's programme at the University of Amsterdam. Amsterdam Merit Scholarship Faculty scholarships for Master's students Each faculty also has a variety of scholarships aimed at international students. Choose a faculty below to find out more about faculty-specific scholarships.
